Background framing for the regional-synergy chapter: Beijing implements its 2016-2035 master plan through the 'three science cities and one area' key functional zones — Zhongguancun Science City (covering all of Haidian), Future Science City (energy/materials shared-technology platforms), Huairou Science City (major scientific facilities), and Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area (innovative industry clusters and manufacturing conversion) (Huairou Science City administrative committee site, reposting Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources material). Page shows no publication date; content circa 2020-2021. Background use only; never cited as statutory control or as evidence of any cooperation with this proposal.
